title: Yellow Rose of Texas — Fit & Bandwagon, 4K for Linux
author: Fit & Bandwagon (Marq, NF), the Debian project, busybox, PRISM
notes: Assembly 2003, 4K intro: OpenGL 1.x of 2003 through SDL, loaded by dlopen, with a soft synth. The intro runs as it was distributed: its dropper, a shell script, unpacks the compressed ELF to /tmp and starts it (busybox's sh, tail, zcat or lzcat), on Debian lenny's libc and dynamic loader (2009). Its libGL, libGLU, libSDL and libasound are made in JavaScript: the OpenGL calls and the GLSL go to PRISM's gl.js (vendor/prism), drawn by WebGL2; /usr/lib/libm.so is libc6-dev's link, the name it opens with dlopen.
